$comment: Contract for the UpdateRole server-side command (AD-003, AD-041, AD-044). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_UpdateRole). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_UpdateRole
customApi.description: Renames, re-describes or retires an al_role. The role code is the stable key assignments and rules reference and never changes. Retiring cascades to them. Enforces permission.manage Manage and writes an immutable Audit Event (BR-012).

requestParameters.name: RoleId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_role record to amend.

requestParameters.name: RoleName
requestParameters.description: New display name. Omit to leave unchanged. The role code never changes.

requestParameters.name: Description
requestParameters.description: New description. Omit to leave unchanged; send an empty string to clear it.

requestParameters.name: Active
requestParameters.description: True to restore the role, false to retire it and cascade to its assignments and rules. Omit to leave unchanged.

requestParameters.name: ExpectedRowVersion
requestParameters.description: Row version for optimistic concurrency. Omit to skip the check.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when the row version did not match and nothing was written.
